definitions.explanation: Makeup applied in excessive amounts, giving an unnatural or overdone appearance. Usually carries a negative nuance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{厚化粧|あつげしょう}だ。
{厚化粧|あつげしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{素顔|すがお}→素顔：13802_sugao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからない。
examples.english: The heavy makeup makes it impossible to tell what her real face looks like.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{厚化粧|あつげしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、かえって⟦{老|ふ}けて→老ける：16742_fukeru⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even young people can look older when they wear too much makeup.

notes:
USAGE:
{厚化粧|あつげしょう} is generally negative, implying the makeup is excessive or tasteless. It is most often used about women but can describe anyone. The opposite is ⟦{薄化粧|うすげしょう}→薄化粧：16437_usugeshou⟧ (light makeup), which has a positive nuance of natural beauty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚化粧|あつげしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ (a heavily made-up woman)
- {厚化粧|あつげしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to put on heavy makeup)
- {厚化粧|あつげしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (to hide behind heavy makeup)

FORMS:
⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) + ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧ (makeup). The reading changes from けしょう to げしょう in this compound (rendaku).
